mechanism_established_from_evidence.what_trace_window_is: the canonical per-transition ledger of the world's own history: before/after state hashes and a trace id
mechanism_established_from_evidence.why_it_differs: state_hash_before and state_hash_after are content-addressed hashes of the arm's OWN canonical state, which necessarily differs because the belief credence differs; trace_id is derived from the trace entry content, which includes those hashes
mechanism_established_from_evidence.classification: ARM-DERIVED HASH BOOKKEEPING, exactly the same class as [projection_hash] in the model-facing request
explicitly_NOT: revision divergence (revision progression is identical across arms)

what_was_already_verified_and_stands.lifecycle_symmetry: PASS — same observation id, same current_observation_ref, same scene, same task (null), same event count (1), same repository revision progression

required_remedy.kind: preregistration amendment, written and hashed BEFORE it is applied
required_remedy.precedent: REVISION 3 did exactly this for [projection_hash]: the admissibility class was extended, hashed, and frozen with MODEL_CALLS_BEFORE_AMENDMENT = 0
required_remedy.candidate_revision_4_scope: extend the admissible arm-dependent state class from {frozen proposition credence} to {frozen proposition credence, arm-derived hash/trace bookkeeping computed from the arm's own state}
must_include: a mechanical enumeration of exactly which trace_window fields are admissible, by name and path
a statement that trace_id difference FOLLOWS from the hash difference and is not independent
a normalisation analogous to normalizeArmSpecificBytes for the state channel, so the gate compares normalised states and any residual difference fails closed
preservation of the REVISION 3 hash and the REVISION 2 hash
must_not: weaken the gate to 'some metadata may differ'
be applied retrospectively to reinterpret this round's result
be written after any treatment call
required_remedy.why_this_is_safe_to_do: MODEL_CALLS_TRANSMITTED = 0, so the amendment is still pre-data; the gate itself was not loosened, its admissible-class list is being completed with a mechanically enumerated, evidence-backed entry
